title: Prisoner had the shakes: Inquest
article: An inquest into the death of Surinder Pal Singh Malhi was told Monday it is common to have people in custody go through serious alcohol withdrawal.
Civilian guards at Surrey RCMP holding cells said it is standard practice to alert an RCMP supervisor when a prisoner becomes erratic or appears to be in medical distress.

Guard Nina Mann recalled seeing Malhi, 58, shaking while being detained on a domestic abuse-related charge just over two years ago. She had been checking on Malhi shortly after he was taken into custody on Dec. 23, 2011 after allegedly breaching a court order to avoid contact with his wife. When she saw Malhi shaking, she spoke to him and he told her he was OK.
After his arrest, Malhi went into alcohol withdrawal, the inquest jury heard. He was taken to hospital Dec. 26 and died four days later.
